in_hebrew.name: Hillery
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hillery הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English 'heh' meaning 'hill' and 'leah' meaning 'clearing'. Hillery may refer to a person living on or near a hill, or a clearing in a hilly area. In Christianity, the name may symbolize the journey of faith, which involves both climbing hills to reach new heights and finding clearings of peace and rest.
